description:
💥 Want FREE access to the FULL Claude Accelerator Course (including 40 pre-built skills)? Like and share your biggest takeaway from this video in the comments, and we'll send you the details!

🐺 Book a Private Zoom Call to get FREE access to my Training & Coaching → https://bit.ly/4wH4iQ0 

Most real estate agents are either paying for a social media manager or spending HOURS every week trying to figure out what to post.

Claude Coworker can do it for you (automatically!) every single week!

In this step by step, click by click tutorial, I show you EXACTLY how to build a fully automated AI content assistant inside Claude Coworker using “six building blocks”: your business profile, a dedicated workspace, custom instructions, a reusable skill, a Google Drive connection, and a scheduled weekly task that delivers your exact content plan every Monday morning without you lifting a finger.

You'll learn:
 ✅ The difference between Claude Chat and Claude Coworker, and why most agents are using the wrong one
 ✅ How to create a business profile so Claude understands your market, avatar, and goals
 ✅ How to set up a Claude Project that acts as your dedicated content assistant workspace
 ✅ How to build a custom Claude Skill so it plans your content the right way every single time
 ✅ How to connect Claude to Google Drive so all your content lives in one organized folder
 ✅ How to set up a Scheduled Task that automatically delivers your Instagram Reels, YouTube topics, and newsletter ideas every Monday at 7am

If you've been wasting time prompting Claude from scratch every week or paying someone to manage your content calendar… this tutorial will CHANGE how you run your business!

💬 Drop a comment with your favorite part of this video and like it, I will reply with FREE access to the FULL Claude Mastery Course including 40 pre-built skills ready to download immediately.
